title: Audit: the nine mandatory ablations gathered from EXP-0003 / EXP-0029 / EXP-0033 into renderable metrics
assumptions: The nine mandatory ablations are not all numeric metrics of the experiments that produced them; several live only in outputs.json. This experiment makes each cell machine-renderable so the paper cannot quote it by hand.

Ablation 5 (independent marginals vs copula) has a negative energy-distance delta but a worse dependence-spectrum MAE; both readings are emitted, and the paper must report the negative energy-distance result rather than hiding it.
This is an audit of existing experiments only: no new data, no new holdout use, no refit. Q1/DATA-0002/TGT-0001 is used only as the registration anchor; the audit covers Q1, Q2 and Q3.
No split is attached, so nothing here consumes SPLIT-0002 holdout exposure.
algorithm: Pure audit/reporting step: reads the registered outputs.json / metrics.json of EXP-0003 (Q1 ablations 1-3), EXP-0029 (Q2 ablation 4 + pi-first diagnostics) and EXP-0033 (Q3 ablations 5-9), asserts that all nine mandatory ablations are present, and re-emits every ablation cell as a numeric metric plus a four-panel figure. No model is fitted here and the Q1 dataset binding is only the registration anchor required by the ledger.

params.note: nine mandatory ablations (blueprint sections 7-8), gathered from the experiments that ran them
